_doc: Config for `nix-switch-progress` — the dark-mode progress window shown during `build.sh switch` on a graphical session (programs/nix-switch-progress.nix). Plasma-native (kdialog → inherits the active KDE dark theme automatically). Driven by parsing `nix build --log-format internal-json` activity events (builds + substitutions, done/expected) into a real %. No labels/icons hardcoded in the .nix/.mjs — all here (data-driven). Over SSH/TTY or with kdialog absent the wrapper passes the command through unchanged (no window). Plan: user asked 2026-06-20.
title: Nix Switch Progress
